pixel: the column at the north-west corner of each step x step cell; north is up
surface: OCEAN_FLOOR_WG: one above the top motion-blocking block; under a roof, one above the first motion-blocking block below the roof's underside
biomeY: the surface height, clamped into the dimension (the generator's noise biome there)

height.grey: 60 at greyFrom to 230 at greyTo (the dry surface's 1st and 99th percentile), lit from the north-west
height.water: blue, darker by depth below sea level

scout.rule: the final density on rows one interpolation cell apart (8 blocks when it is not interpolated); each cell whose rows differ in sign sampled block by block; a layer thinner than a cell between two rows is missed

runs.format: gzip members, big-endian: int magic 0x43445231, int side, int step, int x0, int z0, int minY, int noiseTop; then per pixel, rows north to south, west to east: u8 count, and per run topmost first i16 top, i16 bottom, u16 topBlock, u16 undersideBlock, u16 fluidBlock, i16 fluidLevel (block indices into palette, 65535 for none; fluidLevel is the block above the fluid's surface)

cut.rule: the height open in the most roofed columns of a grid every 64 blocks

fast.tierRule: tierN shows run N+1 from the top, drawn when 0.02 of columns have it
fast.fluids: the level's global fluid picker (sea level, lava level, dry zones) at the lowest open block over each run; an aquifer's local water tables need a noise chunk and are not sampled
fast.surfaceBlocks: the level's compiled material rule at each run's top, and at a roof's underside

structures.rule: starts from the level's placement state with its structure control (Sampler.starts), at most 64 of each structure, outlined by the start's bounding box
